data.name: DetailNoSpace
data.value: Volume group {0} has no free room ({2}), so {1} gets no snapshot and is read as it is. Add a disk of 10–20 GB to the server and put it into the group, the volume itself need not shrink: pvcreate /dev/sdX && vgextend {0} /dev/sdX (replace sdX with the new disk, see lsblk).

data.name: DetailLowSpace
data.value: Volume group {0} has {1} free, and the snapshot of the last run needed {2}. If the changes made to {3} during a run outgrow the free room, the run fails. Add a disk to the group: pvcreate /dev/sdX && vgextend {0} /dev/sdX.

data.name: DetailLowSpaceUnknown
data.value: Volume group {0} has only {1} free for the snapshot of {2}: a run during heavy writing may run out of it. 10–20 GB free is recommended: pvcreate /dev/sdX && vgextend {0} /dev/sdX.

data.name: DetailOverflowed
data.value: The snapshot of {0} ran out of room during the last run ({1}), and that run failed. Give volume group {2} more free room: pvcreate /dev/sdX && vgextend {2} /dev/sdX.

data.name: CliRestoreHelp
data.value:
Usage: custos restore list (--task NAME_OR_ID | --from FOLDER) [--account ID] [--password-stdin] custos restore start (--task NAME_OR_ID | --from FOLDER) --set ID [--destination DEST_ID] (--to FOLDER | --original) [--dumps-to FOLDER] [--existing skip|overwrite-older|overwrite] [--account ID] [--password-stdin] custos restore status custos restore stop
'list' shows the ID to use with --set. Use absolute paths for folders. --account is a saved account for --from on a share. --password-stdin reads one line from redirected input. The task's saved password is used by default. 'start' waits for the restore. Ctrl+C requests cancellation. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 warning or error, 130 cancelled.
